run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with --config and --out-path to fit linear element references
run_fit_linref_function: run fit_linref with a config dict and output path to fit and save element references
fit_linear_references: fit linear references for target properties using a training dataset and batch configuration
save_checkpoint_linref: save the fitted linear reference state dict as a checkpoint file to the output path
load_config_yaml: load a YAML config file with load_config to get config, duplicate warnings, and duplicate errors
